title: A Chess Robot Beat Napoleon. A Man Was Hiding Inside ♟️
caption:
A chess robot beat Napoleon ♟️
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. The Turk, built in 1770, toured Europe as a chess-playing machine and reportedly beat Napoleon and Benjamin Franklin. It was a hoax: a human chess master hid inside the cabinet.
Would you have spotted the trick? 👇
first_comment: The first "AI" was a guy in a box. Some things never change. ♟️👇
